jp: コーチ{に|te-hoshii}もっと厳[きび]しく教[おし]えてほしいです。
en: I want the coach to teach me more strictly.
why: The coach is the person asked to act, and that person is marked with に before ～てほしい.

why: The friend is the one whose action you want, so the friend takes に.
